title: Target moments released under differential privacy
question: When a target trial releases covariate moments under differential privacy, how much does ignoring the added noise cost MAIC coverage at realistic arm sizes and budgets, does propagating its known variance repair it, and when do extra released moments stop paying for their share of the budget?
design: MAIC to Laplace-privatized target means or means and second moments, 48 cells crossing target size (40 to 500), privacy budget, released statistics and linear or quadratic effect modification; non-private, noise-ignored and noise-propagated analyses. 1000 replicates per cell.
answer: Privacy noise is not negligible at usable budgets for trial-sized targets: at epsilon 1 and 150 patients it was 8% to 60% of the estimate's variance and ignoring it cut coverage to 0.88 to 0.94; at 40 patients to 0.73. Its variance is known exactly, and adding it restored coverage in every scenario, conservatively where noise dominated. Releasing second moments pays only at larger budgets; at small ones it made MAIC infeasible in up to 87% of replicates.
findings: Refuting sentence fails: coverage ignoring the noise was as low as 0.883 at epsilon of at least 1 and targets of at least 150.

Propagating the known noise variance gave coverage of at least 0.926 in every private scenario, the minimum matching the non-private analysis's own misspecification; it reached 1.000 where noise dominated.
Releasing means and second moments with a split budget left no feasible weights in 45% to 87% of replicates at 40 to 150 patients and epsilon 0.5 to 1.
Under quadratic modification at epsilon 4 and 150 patients second moments cut RMSE from 0.229 to 0.171.
not_answered: Laplace mechanism only; Gaussian mechanism, released correlations and overlap not varied. Results are conditional on feasible weights. Budget choice and governance are outside the study. Peer review has not been done.
estimand: Target-population mean difference, A versus C, at the target trial's own covariate moments
methods_compared: MAIC to private moments, noise ignored
MAIC to private moments, noise variance propagated
